annotations.title: Current time in a time zone and time zone conversion

description: The exact current date and time in any IANA time zone, with UTC offset, weekday, abbreviation and Unix timestamp, daylight saving time handled. Optionally convert a given moment into up to 10 other time zones in the same call. Use when an agent needs to know what time it is, to schedule a meeting across time zones, or to turn a timestamp into local time. Example: zone=Europe/Stockholm, at=2026-03-01T09:00:00+01:00, to=America/New_York,Asia/Tokyo. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

at.description: Optional moment to convert, as ISO 8601 with an offset (default: now)

to.description: Optional comma-separated time zones to convert the same moment into (max 10)

zone.description: IANA time zone name, e.g. Europe/Stockholm or America/New_York
